definitions.explanation: How a person looks from behind, as when walking away; often used for the impression a departing person leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|うし}ろ{姿|すがた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見送|みおく}った→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧。
examples.english: I watched my father as he walked away.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{姿|すがた}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I knew it was her just from seeing her from behind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|うし}ろ{姿|すがた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦いつの{間|ま}にか→いつの間にか：01812_itsunomanika⟧ずいぶん⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ようになっていた。
examples.english: Watching my son head for the station, I saw that, from behind, he had somehow grown quite big.

notes:
Often carries feeling: a parent watching a child leave, or someone's lonely figure walking away.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後|うし}ろ{姿|すがた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見送|みおく}る→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧: to watch someone go
- {寂|さび}しそうな{後|うし}ろ{姿|すがた}: a lonely figure seen from behind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧: back; also used figuratively, as in ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧ (to learn by watching one's parents)
- ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: figure, appearance
